findings.label: Duplicate CSS comment openers
findings.description: Lines 836–838 and 1150–1152 each have two consecutive unclosed /* comment openers. The first opener is never closed; the blank line between them is silently consumed by the parser. No rules are lost today but any future content inserted between those lines will silently vanish. Remove one opener from each duplicate pair.

findings.label: Redundant overlay2 variable
findings.description: cerebral-hero.js queries #ecoOverlay a second time into overlay2 when overlay already holds the same element. Replace overlay2.appendChild(s) with overlay.appendChild(s) and remove the redundant query.

findings.label: border-sweep animation may be a no-op in some browsers
findings.description: The @keyframes border-sweep animates --angle but whether conic-gradient inside ::before re-evaluates on each frame with @property depends on the browser. Verify the sweep is visually active across target browsers; if not, drive the rotation with a transform on a wrapper element instead.
